analyst.summary: [DATA] GSK India's FY26 growth was margin-led (PAT +10%) not volume-led (revenue +2%), with a CMO-related one-off costing Q4 ~3-3.5pp of topline; NLEM price control still caps ~35-38% of the portfolio. FY27 double-digit-growth guidance is real but partly a low-base bounce. Valuation (P/E ~40x, P/B ~18x) already prices continued execution. Quant scores Hold/Hold with high coverage; no USFDA plant flag found. Recommendation: Hold.
